basis: WP02 retained acceptance criteria, accepted WP01 policy and reviewed architecture amendments; additional to all 32 historical families and 60 documentary expectations.

RF01.claim: Creator, work, claim and relationship review remain independent, and creator review has no work prerequisite.

RF02.claim: Rights apply to an exact artifact version and material; reuse and display remain distinct permissions.

RF03.claim: A stale required head, unauthorized actor, expired dependency, invalid fence or budget, incomplete vector or conflicting operation cannot produce a modeled commit; ABA advances revision.

RF04.claim: Well-formed invalidated, expired or old-incarnation continuations return 410; mismatched input returns 400 and invalid pages contain no rows.

RF05.claim: Unrelated addition advances the generation coordinate without invalidating an otherwise valid snapshot; partition applies only while valid.

RF06.claim: Current professional presence and local contribution at creation have independent eligibility outcomes.

RF07.claim: All six provider routes admit independent artifact discovery, and an institutional creator needs no work; qualification sample is bounded and cannot activate collection.

RF08.claim: Calendar precision does not manufacture UTC instants; unknown timezone cannot authorize an instant, and unknown dates fail positive date filters.

RF09.claim: Provider identity includes provider, installation, kind and nativeId, so same nativeId in distinct forums or account/person namespaces never collides.

limits: These are authored abstract obligations, not authenticated authority, external facts, SQL transactions, UI behavior or provider access. Actual code and operating evidence remain separate.
